source_target_review: Task3 W-media has a separate explicit worker_media_main services_main root. It initializes and pumps one static classic_runtime firmware_runtime and one static firmware_media; classic_runtime itself initializes and pumps the one ble_business_owner firmware_owner, with no duplicate business pump. No ui_main/ui_render translation unit is compiled. A138_SINGLE_BLE_RECORDING selects session-only NoBonding Classic and removes durable-store callback constructors; this role never defines A138_WORKER_AUDIO_ONLY. The existing recording_service TU supplies the data API, but its R00 control API is unreachable from services_main and no physical R00 backend is selected. CPU firmware submit/poll/facts APIs and BLE commands address the same firmware_owner object. The capacity macro is 2880000 in every actual TU. Capacity source adaptations are inverted exactly to immutable reviewed parent identities, never to substitute compile inputs; current real C and header are compiled. Clock/recording/business bus constructors are unchanged and install the inherited mmio, record_mmio and business_mmio read/write functions. hci_transport and PCM use the sole hci_mmio bus constructors; their bus callback sites conservatively include hci_mmio_read/write. Actual PCM callbacks are pcm_poll,pcm_submit,pcm_cancel. cancel_media fixes pcm_cancel; runtime_pass includes poll/submit; fail_runtime fixes hci_mmio_write. Clock callback sites include unchanged mmio_read/write. These closed source points-to sets are applied to this new ELF's exact actual ordered JALR instructions, not copied historical machine bytes. SBC balloc/SpecializedReadSamples/SynthFrame tables are verified word-for-word in this ELF and source format bounds retain their checks. Every reachable unknown JALR, callback target, recursion, unknown/dynamic stack frame or stack overflow fails closed. Interrupts remain disabled. The bound does not establish CPU cycles, memory corruption resistance, physical watermark, radio acceptance, transport measurements, audio output or hardware acceptance. The extended-capacity branch adds one actual data.read callback in a138_ble_business_pump; the sole firmware constructor binds it to record_mmio_read, reading the physical capacity at offset 0x3c before setting bound.
